# Brand assets

Images generated with ChatGPT from the prompts stored next to them, so they can be regenerated or varied.

| File | Size | Use | Prompt |
|---|---|---|---|
| `banner.png` | 2172×724 (3:1) | README header | [`banner-prompt.json`](banner-prompt.json) |
| `banner-alt.png` | 2172×724 (3:1) | Alternative header | [`banner-alt-prompt.json`](banner-alt-prompt.json) |
| `logo.png` | 1254×1254 | Square icon, social avatar | [`logo-prompt.json`](logo-prompt.json), in the same chat as the banner |
| `logo-512.png` | 512×512 | Web / app icon | resized from `logo.png` |
| `apple-touch-icon.png` | 180×180 | iPhone / iPad home screen (`<link rel="apple-touch-icon">`) | resized from `logo.png` |
| `favicon-32.png` | 32×32 | Browser favicon | resized from `logo.png` |

The icons are full-bleed squares without rounded corners: iOS and browsers apply their own mask.
